acceptance: Journey, red first: a floor run fails one test once: the retake passes, the build goes on, and a signal names the test.
A second red fails the floor and names the test.
A failure with 10 KB of later output keeps the test name.
A package with a retake emits a signal that evolve ci classify can read.
Docs: the spec and package notes change in STE; 100% coverage on each changed function; zero code comments; a journey test through the real entry point, proven red without the fix.
fix: The floor and the audit tier share one scope function. A red floor retakes the failed packages once, serialized. The diagnostic keeps each failed test name first.
